eindtekst: From the tagged table list to a single table's real rows: /data keeps a growing workspace navigable, /table/[name] browses one table in full.

stappen.tekst: Data lists every table in the workspace as a card: name, field and record counts, plus its tags. Two live here: superstore and regions.
Click a card and its settings drawer slides in: rename, group, tag, column types, source.
Group and Tags are workspace metadata, not table data: a group folders the card, tags label it. Retagging never rewrites the table.
Type a tag in the Tags field and press Enter; it lands as a chip.
Save changes writes name, group and tags to the internal metadata tables in one go.
stappen.klaar: Saved; back on the refreshed list.

stappen.tekst: Back on Data each card carries its tags, and the filter bar appears: one chip per tag in the workspace. regions is tagged demo data.
Click a tag chip to narrow the list to tables carrying it; click again to clear.
stappen.klaar: List filtered to the retail tag.

stappen.tekst: Open on a card goes to that table's detail page.
stappen.klaar: Table detail open with real rows.

stappen.tekst: The detail page pages through the actual rows, 20 at a time. Query this table drops the same SELECT straight into the SQL editor.
